configuration.sampling_scope: Fixed first R saved branch paths, analytically averaged ideal mixture; pilot only, no original sampling-budget certification.

bootstrap.scope: Paired empirical trajectory resampling within observed batches plus joint control-PUB resampling; shot noise already present in path means is not resampled again. Conditional on observed jobs and twirl variants; omits drift and calibration-model bias. Intervals descriptive, not simultaneous. Small-group bootstrap precision can be poor; fixed-path delta-method SEs are also reported.

statistics.scope: Marginal SPAM model is conditional on stable local response and includes preparation error. CZ-only extrapolation does not remove intentional reservoir dissipation, finite-step bias, or guarantee removal of reset/idle noise. No clipping or reference fitting.
